points.place: 比利牛斯-大西洋省西布列塔尼地区
points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 拉威尔出生于法国西南部的西布列塔尼地区，母亲是巴斯克人，父亲是瑞士工程师。这个多文化背景对他的音乐风格产生了深远影响。童年时期，他展现出对音乐的早期天赋，开始学习钢琴。这段经历培养了他对民间音乐和异国情调的敏感度，这些元素后来成为他作品的重要特色。他的母亲是音乐爱好者，鼓励他发展音乐才能，为他提供了早期的音乐教育环境。
points.descriptionEn: Ravel was born in Ciboure, a small town in southwestern France, to a Swiss father and a Basque mother. This multicultural background profoundly influenced his musical style. During his childhood, he showed early musical talent and began piano studies. This period nurtured his sensitivity to folk music and exoticism, elements that became important features of his later works. His mother, a music enthusiast, encouraged his musical development and provided him with an early musical education environment.

points.title: 巴黎音乐学院求学
points.description: 拉威尔进入巴黎音乐学院学习，师从著名钢琴家和作曲家费迪南德·德·热罗姆和加布里埃尔·福洛。尽管他在钢琴演奏上表现出色，但在作曲比赛中屡次失败，这促使他发展出独特的个人风格。在此期间，他接触到德彪西等印象派作曲家的作品，深受影响。他创作了早期作品如《古风小步舞曲》(Pavane pour une infante défunte)和《水之嬉戏》(Jeux d'eau)，这些作品展现了他对色彩和音色的独特处理方式，预示了他未来印象主义风格的发展。
points.descriptionEn: Ravel entered the Paris Conservatory, studying under renowned pianist and composer Ferdinand de Gerôme and Gabriel Fauré. Despite his excellent piano skills, he repeatedly failed in composition competitions, which led him to develop a unique personal style. During this period, he was deeply influenced by the works of impressionist composers like Debussy. He created early works such as 'Pavane pour une infante défunte' and 'Jeux d'eau', which showcased his unique approach to color and timbre, foreshadowing his future impressionist style development.

points.title: 创作巅峰期
points.description: 这是拉威尔创作的黄金时期，他创作了多部代表作品，包括《镜子》(Miroirs)、《夜之幽灵》(Gaspard de la nuit)、《西班牙狂想曲》(Rapsodie espagnole)、《达芙妮与克罗埃》(Daphnis et Chloé)等。这一时期，他发展出独特的音乐语言，融合了印象主义的色彩、古典主义的结构和民间音乐的元素。他的作品以精确的管弦乐配器和丰富的音色著称。同时，他作为钢琴演奏家和指挥家活跃于巴黎音乐界，与斯特拉文斯基等作曲家交往密切。他的作品虽然受到欢迎，但在保守的法国音乐界仍面临争议，被指责为过于注重形式而非情感表达。
points.descriptionEn: This was Ravel's golden period of composition, during which he created many representative works including 'Miroirs', 'Gaspard de la nuit', 'Rapsodie espagnole', and 'Daphnis et Chloé'. During this time, he developed a unique musical language that combined impressionistic color, classical structure, and folk music elements. His works were known for their precise orchestration and rich timbre. Simultaneously, he was active in Paris's music scene as a pianist and conductor, closely associating with composers like Stravinsky. Although his works were popular, they still faced controversy in conservative French music circles, where he was accused of emphasizing form over emotional expression.

points.title: 一战服役
points.description: 第一次世界大战爆发后，拉威尔虽然因年龄和健康状况被免除兵役，但他坚持参军，成为一名卡车司机和救护车驾驶员。这段经历对他产生了深远影响，使他远离了音乐创作环境。战争期间，他经历了严酷的战场生活，目睹了战争的残酷。尽管如此，他仍尝试在业余时间创作，完成了钢琴组曲《库普兰之墓》(Le tombeau de Couperin)，这部作品既是对法国巴洛克作曲家库普兰的致敬，也是对战争中逝去朋友的纪念。战争结束后，他的音乐风格发生了微妙变化，更加内省和深刻。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War I, although exempted from military service due to age and health, Ravel insisted on enlisting, becoming a truck driver and ambulance driver. This experience had a profound impact on him, removing him from his musical environment. During the war, he experienced harsh battlefield life and witnessed the cruelty of war. Despite this, he attempted to compose in his spare time, completing the piano suite 'Le tombeau de Couperin', which was both a tribute to French Baroque composer Couperin and a memorial to friends who died in the war. After the war, his musical style underwent subtle changes, becoming more introspective and profound.

points.title: 晚期创作与疾病
points.description: 战后，拉威尔进入创作晚期，创作了《波莱罗舞曲》(Boléro)、《G大调钢琴协奏曲》和《D大调钢琴协奏曲》等重要作品。1928年，他前往美国巡回演出，获得了国际声誉。然而，从1930年代初开始，他受到脑部疾病的困扰，创作能力逐渐下降。1932年，他遭遇车祸，进一步损害了他的健康。尽管如此，他仍继续创作直到1937年。晚年，他计划创作一部钢琴协奏曲，但因健康原因未能完成。1937年12月28日，拉威尔因脑部手术并发症在巴黎逝世，享年62岁。他的去世标志着法国音乐黄金时代的结束，对20世纪音乐产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After the war, Ravel entered his late creative period, producing important works such as 'Boléro', 'Piano Concerto in G major', and 'Piano Concerto in D major'. In 1928, he toured the United States, gaining international recognition. However, from the early 1930s, he suffered from brain disease, which gradually diminished his compositional abilities. In 1932, he was involved in a car accident that further damaged his health. Despite this, he continued composing until 1937. In his later years, he planned to compose a piano concerto but was unable to complete it due to health reasons. On December 28, 1937, Ravel died in Paris from complications of brain surgery at the age of 62. His death marked the end of France's golden age of music and had a profound impact on 20th-century music.

appraisal.zh: 拉威尔通常被视为二十世纪最重要的法国作曲家之一，也是连接浪漫主义与现代音乐的桥梁：他既保持古典式的严谨结构，又以出色的管弦乐配器开拓了新的音响世界，《波莱罗舞曲》《达芙妮与克罗埃》至今仍是音乐会常演曲目。他与德彪西并列为法国印象主义的代表，但作品更见清晰与结构感。也有研究者指出，他的音乐偏重技巧与形式，近乎精致的工艺品，晚期作品不如早期富于创新；在法国乐界还曾被保守派指为过于德国化。
appraisal.en: Ravel is generally seen as one of the foremost French composers of the twentieth century and a bridge between Romanticism and modern music: he kept classical rigor of structure while opening new sonorities through masterly orchestration, and works such as Boléro and Daphnis et Chloé remain concert staples. He is ranked with Debussy as a representative of French Impressionism, though his music is more clearly structured. Yet some researchers note that his music leans toward technique and form, almost exquisite craft, with later works less inventive than earlier ones, and French conservatives once called him too Germanized.

supporter.zh: 拉威尔被视为20世纪最伟大的法国作曲家之一，他的作品完美融合了印象主义的色彩、古典主义的结构和民间音乐的活力。支持者赞扬他无与伦比的管弦乐配器技巧，能够创造出丰富而细腻的音响效果。他的音乐虽然形式严谨，但充满了情感深度和想象力。拉威尔对音乐语言的创新，特别是在和声与节奏方面的探索，为现代音乐开辟了新途径。他的作品如《波莱罗舞曲》和《达芙妮与克罗埃》至今仍是音乐会上的经典曲目，展现了永恒的艺术价值。
supporter.en: Ravel is regarded as one of the greatest French composers of the 20th century, whose works perfectly blend impressionistic color, classical structure, and folk vitality. Supporters praise his unparalleled orchestration skills, capable of creating rich and nuanced sound effects. Although his music has rigorous form, it is filled with emotional depth and imagination. Ravel's innovations in musical language, particularly in harmony and rhythm, opened new paths for modern music. His works such as 'Boléro' and 'Daphnis et Chloé' remain concert staples today, demonstrating eternal artistic value.

critic.zh: 批评者认为拉威尔的音乐过于注重技巧和形式，缺乏真正的情感深度。一些评论家指责他的作品是'精致的工艺品'而非发自内心的艺术表达。在法国音乐界，他曾被保守派批评为过于'德国化'，背离了法国音乐传统。此外，拉威尔对完美的追求有时导致他反复修改作品，甚至放弃已经完成的创作。他的晚期作品被一些评论家认为缺乏早期作品的创新性和活力。还有人批评他未能充分利用自己的才华，在音乐发展的关键时刻未能做出更具突破性的贡献。
critic.en: Critics argue that Ravel's music places excessive emphasis on technique and form, lacking genuine emotional depth. Some commentators accuse his works of being 'exquisite crafts' rather than heartfelt artistic expressions. In French music circles, he was criticized by conservatives for being too 'Germanized' and deviating from French musical traditions. Furthermore, Ravel's pursuit of perfection sometimes led him to repeatedly revise works or even abandon completed compositions. His later works have been criticized by some for lacking the innovation and vitality of his earlier works. Others argue that he failed to fully utilize his talent and failed to make more breakthrough contributions at critical moments in musical development.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，拉威尔被定义为连接浪漫主义与现代音乐的重要桥梁。他的音乐既保留了古典主义的优雅，又融入了印象主义的创新，形成了独特的个人风格。在流行文化中，他的《波莱罗舞曲》因其独特的节奏结构而广为人知，常被用于电影和广告中。拉威尔的作品对电影音乐产生了深远影响，许多电影作曲家都借鉴了他的配器技巧。在音乐史上，他与德彪西一起被视为法国印象主义音乐的代表人物，但他的作品比德彪西更具结构性和清晰度。拉威尔的音乐遗产体现在他对音色和管弦乐配器的创新，以及对民间音乐元素的巧妙运用上。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Ravel is defined as an important bridge connecting Romanticism and modern music. His music preserves classical elegance while incorporating impressionist innovation, forming a unique personal style. In popular culture, his 'Boléro' is widely known for its unique rhythmic structure and is often used in films and advertisements. Ravel's works have had a profound impact on film music, with many film composers drawing inspiration from his orchestration techniques. In music history, he is regarded alongside Debussy as a representative of French impressionist music, but his works are more structured and clearer than Debussy's. Ravel's musical legacy is reflected in his innovations in timbre and orchestration, as well as his skillful use of folk music elements.

self.zh: 对我来说，形式和内容是一回事。我无法想象没有形式的内容，也无法想象没有内容的形式。
self.en: For me, form and content are one and the same thing. I cannot imagine content without form, nor form without content.
